title: Garden Zone
description: Garden Zone is a small, chill mod that adds more plants, and more functionality for said plants. yeah! :D
body:
Garden Zone is a small, casual mod that adds more plants, more foods, and more stuff regarding plants!

# What does this mod ACTUALLY add?
Garden Zone adds the following:
- More Functions for Sunflowers (Sunflower Seeds and Budding Sunflowers)
- Tomato Plants
- Blueberry Bushes
- Frostberry Bushes
- Clemetine Trees (Not big, and yes, not oranges ;>)
- Starfruit Tree
- New Cactus Type (Small Cactus, drops Prickly Pears.)
- Enchanted Berry Plants
- Fruit Juicer Block
- Plant Clipper Tool (Gives you foods, without removing the plant!)
- New Structures!
- New Biomes!

# What do you do in this mod?
This mod is meant to just be an addon to your worlds! Getting or finding the new content isn't needed for progression in the game.

But you can get the stuff in the mod if you want!



That is all, goodbye! :D
